## Data Cleaning and Imputation Rules


| Domain / Variable                                   |                                                                   Description | Issue                                                                                                                   | Rule applied (what we did in code)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------: | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Inpatient**                                       |                                                                               |                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| PROCODE3                                            |                                                             Organisation code | Missing                                                                                                                 | Replaced with valid codes drawn from a validated random sample.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| PROVSPNO                                            |                                                         Hospital spell number | Missing                                                                                                                 | Replaced with valid codes drawn from a validated random sample.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Outpatient (OMOP)**                               |                                                                               |                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| mainspef                                            |          Main specialty code for the appointment (renamed from mainspef_code) | Missing or invalid                                                                                                      | 1) If mainspef missing/invalid and tretspef is valid (in valid_mainspef_codes) copy tretspef → mainspef. 2) If still missing: fill mainspef with the modal mainspef conditional on tretspef (i.e. most frequent mainspef among rows with the same tretspef) where available. 3) If conditional mode not available, replace with global mode. (All fills applied only for attended appointments in the OP pipeline; attended rows were retained for imputations.) Diagnostics counts captured after each step.                                      |
| tretspef                                            |     Treatment specialty code for the appointment (renamed from tretspef_code) | Missing or invalid                                                                                                      | Mirror of mainspef: copy mainspef → tretspef if valid; else conditional mode (modal tretspef for that mainspef); else global mode. Diagnostics counts captured.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| mainspef & tretspef                                 |                                                          Both specialty codes | Both missing                                                                                                            | If appointment **attended**, impute using global mode (after attempting conditional modes). If **not attended**, drop / exclude from cost calculations (non-user).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| firstatt                                            |                                                   First / follow-up indicator | Invalid value `"X"`                                                                                                     | Replace `"X"` with `"4"` (follow-up telephone/telemedicine — chosen as least resource-intensive).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| additional OMOP OP steps                            |                                                                               |                                                                                                                         | Valid code lists enforced via `valid_mainspef_codes` and `valid_tretspef_codes`. Temporary columns created (new_mainspef, new_tretspef etc.) and diagnostics produced (# replaced / imputed). `&` placeholder cleaned to NA where present; text→numeric conversion performed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **Outpatient (CPRD → costing)**                     |                                                                               |                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| data merge                                          | Bring patient covariates required by grouper (age/sex) into appointment table | Missing covariates for grouper                                                                                          | Left-join `appt_data` to `_validation_old` to obtain yob and gender; compute startage and convert sex to numeric codes for grouper (F → 2, else 1).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| users vs non-users                                  |                                                    OP non-users (no apptdate) | apptdate = NA                                                                                                           | Non-users filtered out for costing pipeline and exported; later re-attached with `unit_cost = 0` and `em_hrg / nac_hrg = NA`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| mainspef / tretspef cleaning                        |                                           See OMOP rules above (very similar) | Missing/invalid codes and `&` placeholders                                                                              | Replace `&` with NA; cast to numeric; apply: copy-valid-from-other, conditional-mode imputation, global-mode fallback (applies to attended rows). Counts (how many replaced/imputed) reported.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| attended filtering                                  |                                   Only attended appointments used for costing | Non-attended appointments should not be costed                                                                          | Filter `filter(!is.na(apptdate))` and set an `attended_flag` (attended == 5 used as indicator where applicable). Non-attended rows kept separately and assigned cost=0.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| firstatt handling                                   |                                                               FIRSTATT == "X" | Invalid                                                                                                                 | Replace `"X"` → `"4"` (telephone/telemedicine).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| OP costing (NHS Collection Costs 2024/25, OP sheet) |                                           Compute HRG-level unit costs for OP | NHS table includes suppressed attendances (`*` meaning <5) and cost unit per HRG not directly provided at patient-level | 1) Import OP sheet, `clean_names()`. 2) Flag `has_star_cost = grepl("\\*", number_of_attendances)` and replace suppressed `*` counts with `3`. 3) Convert `number_of_attendances` to numeric. 4) Group by `(tretspef, nac_hrg)` and compute `total_costs = sum(cost)`, `total_attendances = sum(number_of_attendances)`, and `unit_cost = total_costs/total_attendances`. 5) Keep distinct `(tretspef, nac_hrg, unit_cost)` and join to patient OP table by `tretspef` and `nac_hrg` (`nac_hrg` was renamed from `currency_code` in the NHS file). |
| Unit cost join                                      |                                                  Apply unit costs to patients | Some patients lack matching HRG or tretspef                                                                             | Left-join HRG-level `unit_cost` onto patient-level OP data (by `tretspef` and `nac_hrg`). Patients without matches have `unit_cost = NA` and are handled diagnostically; non-users later assigned `unit_cost = 0`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Emergency Care (CPRD / HES HRG / AE source)**     |                                                                               |                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| inv / treat                                         |                      Emergency investigation and treatment codes (INV, TREAT) | SNOMED codes not accepted by grouper                                                                                    | Map SNOMED → grouper-compatible values using ETOS v4.0.8 mapping.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| em_hrg                                              |                                                   Emergency Medicine HRG code | Missing or suppressed activity counts in reference costs                                                                | Import NHS Collection Costs 2024/25 (EM sheet). Flag suppressed attendances (`*`) and replace with `3`. Group by `em_hrg` to compute `total_costs` and `total_attendances`, then compute `unit_cost = total_costs/total_attendances`. Join HRG-level `unit_cost` to AE patient records by `em_hrg`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| AE non-users                                        |                                   Patients with no AE utilisation (non-users) | No HRG/cost                                                                                                             | Imported non-user file, assigned `em_hrg = NA` and `unit_cost = 0`, `user_status = "Non-User"`. Non-users are rbound back to user table to create final AE cost dataset.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Diagnostics                                         |                                                                               |                                                                                                                         | Summary diagnostics computed (total records, missing unit_cost, % missing).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **Emergency Care (OMOP AE)**                        |                                                                               |                                                                                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| inv & treat                                         |                             Investigation and treatment not mapped in OMOP AE | Not available / not mapped                                                                                              | When INV/TREAT detail unavailable for OMOP AE records, costs were assigned using a single **weighted average A&E attendance cost**: compute `(sum(cost) / sum(number_of_attendances))` from NHS Collection Costs 2024/25 (EM) after replacing suppressed attendance counts `*` → `3`. That weighted cost is applied to OMOP AE attendances lacking inv/treat mapping.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| EM weighted cost computation                        |                        Weighted average cost per A&E attendance used for OMOP |                                                                                                                         | Import `EM` sheet; convert `number_of_attendances` (`*` → 3), strip `£`/commas from `cost`, convert to numeric; compute `em_weighted_cost = round(sum(cost)/sum(number_of_attendances), 2)`. Store as single-value `em_weighted_cost_df` and apply where necessary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

**Summary of the table**

Outpatient specialty codes (MAINSPEF, TRETSPEF) were harmonised and imputed in several steps. We first treated non-numeric placeholders (e.g. `&`) as missing and enforced valid code lists. If one specialty was missing and the other was valid we copied the valid code across. Where one code remained missing we imputed the most frequent corresponding specialty conditional on the present code (modal `MAINSPEF` for each `TRETSPEF` and modal `TRETSPEF` for each `MAINSPEF`). Remaining missing values for attended appointments were replaced by the global mode. Invalid `FIRSTATT` values (`"X"`) were replaced with `"4"` (follow-up telephone). For outpatient and emergency costing we used NHS Collection Costs 2024/25: suppressed activity counts indicated by `*` were set to `3`, and HRG-level unit costs were calculated as total reported cost divided by total attendances. HRG-level unit costs were left-joined to patient-level records; patients with no attendance were assigned cost = 0. For OMOP AE records lacking mapped investigation/treatment, a weighted average A&E attendance cost (total EM cost ÷ total attendances, `*` →3) was applied.


**Variable → OMOP status (AE & OP scripts)**

| Variable / name used in script                  |                           OMOP table (source) | OMOP column type / status                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------: | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **visit_detail_id**                             |                                `visit_detail` | OMOP identifier (CDM primary key for the visit_detail row). **Not** a standardised clinical concept — an internal ID.                                      |
| **person_id**                                   |         `visit_detail` (joined with `person`) | OMOP identifier linking to `person.person_id`. **Not** a clinical concept; key used to join to person.                                                     |
| **provider_id**                                 |       `visit_detail` (joined with `provider`) | OMOP identifier linking to `provider.provider_id`. **Not** a clinical concept.                                                                             |
| **visit_detail_start_date**                     |                                `visit_detail` | OMOP date/time column (standard CDM field) — event date.                                                                                                   |
| **visit_detail_concept_id**                     |                                `visit_detail` | OMOP **standardised concept id** (an integer concept_id representing the visit type, e.g. 9202/9203). This is a mapped, standard concept.                  |
| **preceding_visit_detail_id**                   |                                `visit_detail` | OMOP identifier (links to previous `visit_detail_id`). **Not** a clinical concept.                                                                         |
| **year_of_birth**                               |                                      `person` | OMOP standard person column (demographic). **Not** a concept id — demographic numeric field.                                                               |
| **specialty_concept_id**                        |            `provider` (joined into appt_data) | OMOP **standardised concept id** for provider specialty (mapped concept).                                                                                  |
| **specialty_source_value**                      |            `provider` (joined into appt_data) | OMOP **source value** — the original provider specialty code/text from the source system (raw source).                                                     |
| **gender_source_value**                         | `person` (joined into appt_with_patient_info) | OMOP **source value** for gender (original text/code from source). Note: `person` also has `gender_concept_id` if you need a mapped standard concept.      |
| **subject_id** (in `cohort_table`)              |                 `cohort_table` (study cohort) | Study-specific identifier that maps to `person_id` (used in the left_join). **Not** an OMOP column — a cohort variable that references `person.person_id`. |
| **index_date** / **follow_up_end**              |          `cohort_table` (and used in filters) | Study-derived dates (cohort variables). **Not** OMOP columns — used to restrict the time window for OMOP events.                                           |
| **visit_detail_concept_id == 9203** (AE filter) |                                `visit_detail` | Uses OMOP standard **concept id** value (9203) to identify AE attendances. Standard concept filter.                                                        |
| **visit_detail_concept_id == 9202** (OP filter) |                                `visit_detail` | Uses OMOP standard **concept id** value (9202) to identify outpatient attendances. Standard concept filter.                                                |

**Short explanation**

Variables labelled `*_concept_id` (for example `visit_detail_concept_id`, `specialty_concept_id`) are OMOP standardised concept identifiers mapped by the OMOP vocabulary. Fields ending in `_source_value` (for example `specialty_source_value`, `gender_source_value`) are the original source system codes/text and are not standardised. Identifiers such as person_id, visit_detail_id and provider_id are CDM keys used for linkage (not clinical concepts). `index_date` and `follow_up_end` are `study-derived` cohort variables used to filter OMOP events.

# Outpatients HRCU Analysis {.tabset}

## Healthcare Service Users Comparison between Source and OMOP

```{r}
contigency_table_for_user_status_rp <- import(here("OMOP Analysis","Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "Comparison", "OP", "contigency_table_for_user_status.xlsx")) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.) | . == "NA", "", .))) %>%   mutate(Total = as.numeric(Total))

contigency_table_for_user_status_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Contigency Table for Outpatient Service Users**"),
    subtitle = md("*Comparison between OMOP and Source*")
  ) %>%
  # opt_all_caps() %>% 
  tab_options(
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) %>%
  # Add spanner headers for CPRD Raw and OMOP Analysis
  tab_spanner(
    label = "OMOP",
    columns = c("Non-User", "Not in OMOP", "User")
  ) %>%
   opt_stylize(style = 1) %>% 
  fmt_number(
    columns = c("Non-User", "Not in OMOP", "User", "Total"),
    sep_mark = ",",
    decimals = 0
  ) %>% 
  sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "")
```

## Overall{.tabset}

### Plots

```{r fig.cap="Distribution of the overall visits"}
# Read images
Mean_visits_overall_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis","Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "OP", "Plots", "Mean_appts_hist_users-Raw.PNG"))
Mean_visits_overall_OMOP <- readPNG(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "OP", "Plots",  "Mean_appts_hist_users-OMOP.PNG"))

# Wrap them in rasterGrob
Mean_visits_overall_Raw_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_visits_overall_Raw, interpolate = TRUE)
Mean_visits_overall_OMOP_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_visits_overall_OMOP, interpolate = TRUE)

# Add titles with arrangeGrob 
Mean_visits_overall_Raw_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_visits_overall_Raw_g, top = textGrob("Source", gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))) 
Mean_visits_overall_OMOP_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_visits_overall_Raw_g, top = textGrob("OMOP", gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))) 

grid.arrange(Mean_visits_overall_Raw_g_with_title, Mean_visits_overall_OMOP_g_with_title, ncol = 2)

```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
specialty_plot <- readPNG(here("OMOP Analysis","Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "Comparison", "OP", "Plots", "combined_specialty_plot.PNG")) 
grid.raster(specialty_plot)
```

### Observed

```{r}
source_overall_observed_users <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "OP", "Overall","Output_appointments_Raw.xlsx"),
                                  sheet = "users_overall_summary_appts") %>% 
  mutate(`Patient Category` = "Users & all encounters") %>% 
  select(!`Patient Category`) %>% 
  mutate(`Data Source` = "Source") %>% 
  select(`Data Source`, everything())

omop_overall_observed_users <- import(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "OP", "Overall","Output_appointments_OMOP.xlsx"),
                                  sheet = "users_overall_summary_appts") %>% 
  mutate(`Patient Category` = "Users & all encounters") %>% 
  select(!`Patient Category`) %>% 
  mutate(`Data Source` = "OMOP") %>% 
  select(`Data Source`, everything())


overall_observed_visits_users <- rbind(
  source_overall_observed_users,
  omop_overall_observed_users)

overall_observed_visits_users %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Overall HES Outpatient Visits**"),
    subtitle = md("**Healthcare HES Outpatient Users**")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      table.width = px(800),
      #heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      #table.font.names = "Times New Roman"
      table.font.size = px(14)
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>% 
  cols_label(
    n = "Number of Patients",
    mean = "Mean",
    min = "Minimum",
    max = "Maximum",
    sd = "Standard Deviation",
    median = "Median",
    lower_q = "Lower Quartile",
    upper_q = "Upper Quartile",
    se = "Standard Error",
    ci_lower = "95% CI Lower",
    ci_upper = "95% CI Upper"
  )
```

### Bootstrap

```{r}
source_overall_all_patients_all_enc_boot <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "OP", "Overall", "overall_bootstrap_summary_encounters_SOURCE.xlsx")) %>% 
  filter(group == "All Patients & all encounters") %>%
  select(!group) %>%
  rename(
    Mean = mean,
    Variance = variance,
    `Standard Deviation` = sd,
    `Standard Error` = se,
    `95% Lower CI-First order normal approximation` = ci_norm_lower,
    `95% Upper CI-First order normal approximation` = ci_norm_upper,
    `95% Lower CI-Basic bootstrap interval` = ci_basic_lower,
    `95% Upper CI-Basic bootstrap interval` = ci_basic_upper,
    `95% Lower CI-Bootstrap percentile interval` = ci_perc_lower,
    `95% Upper CI-Bootstrap percentile interval` = ci_perc_upper

  mutate(Cohort = "SOURCE") %>% 
  select(Cohort, everything())
```

## Yearly {.tabset}

### Observed

```{r}
source_yearly_all_patients_enc_obs <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "OP", "Yearly", "yearly_combined_summary_encounters_SOURCE.xlsx")) %>% 
   filter(group == "All Patients & all encounters") %>%
```

# Accident & Emergency HRCU Analysis {.tabset}

## Healthcare Service Users Comparison between Source and OMOP

```{r}
ae_contigency_table_for_user_status_rp <- import(here("OMOP Analysis","Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "Comparison", "AE", "contigency_table_for_user_status.xlsx")) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.) | . == "NA", "", .))) %>%   mutate(Total = as.numeric(Total))

ae_contigency_table_for_user_status_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Contigency Table for A&E Service Users**"),
    subtitle = md("*Comparison between OMOP and Source*")
  ) %>%
  # opt_all_caps() %>% 
  tab_options(
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) %>%
  # Add spanner headers for CPRD Raw and OMOP Analysis
  tab_spanner(
    label = "OMOP",
    columns = c("Non-User", "Not in OMOP", "User")
  ) %>%
   opt_stylize(style = 1) %>% 
  fmt_number(
    columns = c("Non-User", "Not in OMOP", "User", "Total"),
    sep_mark = ",",
    decimals = 0
  ) %>% 
  sub_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "")
```


## Overall{.tabset}

### Plots

```{r fig.cap="Distribution of the overall visits"}
# Read images
Mean_ae_visits_overall_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis","Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "AE", "Plots", "Mean_atts_hist_users-Raw.PNG"))
Mean_ae_visits_overall_OMOP <- readPNG(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "SecondaryCareAnalysis", "AE", "Plots",  "Mean_atts_hist_users-OMOP.PNG"))

# Wrap them in rasterGrob
Mean_ae_visits_overall_Raw_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_ae_visits_overall_Raw, interpolate = TRUE)
Mean_ae_visits_overall_OMOP_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_ae_visits_overall_OMOP, interpolate = TRUE)

# Add titles with arrangeGrob 
Mean_ae_visits_overall_Raw_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_ae_visits_overall_Raw_g, top = textGrob("Source", gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))) 
Mean_ae_visits_overall_OMOP_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_ae_visits_overall_Raw_g, top = textGrob("OMOP", gp = gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"))) 

grid.arrange(Mean_ae_visits_overall_Raw_g_with_title, Mean_ae_visits_overall_OMOP_g_with_title, ncol = 2)
```
